practices-9-36-37-twelve-lunar-months-fo.title: Twelve Lunar Months, Four Sacred Months, and Banning Intercalation (al-Nasi')
practices-9-36-37-twelve-lunar-months-fo.note: Surah 9:36–37 fixes the year at twelve lunar months with four sacred truce months and abolishes pre-Islamic Arabian calendar postponement (al-nasi'), which shifted sacred status between Muharram and Safar as recorded in Sahih al-Bukhari 4406 and al-Tabari.

discussion.view: Islamic tradition holds that God ordained twelve lunar months and four sacred truce months at creation for Abraham's sanctuary, and that pagan Kinanah calendar-keepers corrupted this order through postponement (al-nasi').
discussion.reply: Sahih al-Bukhari 4406 and Tafsir al-Tabari on 9:37 confirm that the four sacred truce months—Dhu al-Qa'dah, Dhu al-Hijjah, Muharram, and Rajab Mudar—together with the intercalary office of Junadah ibn 'Awf (Abu Thumamah) of Kinanah were institutions of pre-Islamic Arabian tribal law designed to synchronize seasonal trade and pilgrimage fairs.

practices-9-36-37-twelve-lunar-months-fo.quranEn: [36] Surely the number of months with God is twelve, (written) in the Book of God on the day when He created the heavens and the earth. Of them, four are sacred. That is the right religion. Do not do yourselves evil during them, but fight (against) the idolaters all together, as they fight you all together, and know that God is with the ones who guard (themselves). [37] The postponement is an increase of disbelief by which those who disbelieve go astray. They make it profane (one) year, and make it sacred (another) year, to adjust the number (of months) God has made sacred, and to profane what God has made sacred. The evil of their deeds is made to appear enticing to them, but God does not guide the people who are disbelievers.
quranHighlights: Surely the number of months with God is twelve
The postponement is an increase of disbelief
They make it profane (one) year, and make it sacred (another) year

sources.title: Sahih al-Bukhari (Abu Bakrah on the Twelve Months and Four Sacred Months)
sources.workSub: Sahih al-Bukhari (Abu Bakrah on the Twelve Months and Four Sacred Months)
sources.en: Narrated Abu Bakra:The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Time has taken its original shape which it had when Allah created the Heavens and the Earth. The year is of twelve months, four of which are sacred, and out of these (four) three are in succession, i.e. Dhul-Qa'da, Dhul-Hijja and Al-Muharram, and the fourth is Rajab which is named after the Mudar tribe, between (the month of) Jumaida (ath-thania) and Sha'ban."
highlights: The year is of twelve months, four of which are sacred, and out of these (four) three are in succession, i.e. Dhul-Qa'da, Dhul-Hijja and Al-Muharram, and the fourth is Rajab which is named after the Mudar tribe
sources.orig: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَيُّوبُ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي بَكْرَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ الزَّمَانُ قَدِ اسْتَدَارَ كَهَيْئَةِ يَوْمَ خَلَقَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضَ، السَّنَةُ اثْنَا عَشَرَ شَهْرًا مِنْهَا أَرْبَعَةٌ حُرُمٌ ثَلاَثَةٌ مُتَوَالِيَاتٌ ذُو الْقَعْدَةِ وَذُو الْحِجَّةِ وَالْمُحَرَّمُ، وَرَجَبُ مُضَرَ الَّذِي بَيْنَ جُمَادَى وَشَعْبَانَ، أَىُّ شَهْرٍ هَذَا ‏"‏ قُلْنَا اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ أَعْلَمُ‏.‏

sources.title: Tafsir al-Tabari
sources.en: "'The postponement' (Al-Nasi') is that 'Junadah bin 'Awf bin Umayyah Al-Kinani' used to arrive at the season (of Hajj) every year, and his patronymic was 'Abu Thumamah', so he would call out: 'Verily, Abu Thumamah is neither opposed nor faulted. Verily, Safar of the first year is profane this year,' so he makes it profane for the people. Thus he makes Safar sacred one year, and makes Al-Muharram sacred one year. And that is His saying, Exalted is He: {The postponement is an increase of disbelief} until His saying: {the disbelievers}. And His saying: {The postponement is an increase of disbelief}, He says: they leave Al-Muharram (profane) one year, and one year they make it sacred."
highlights: Thus he makes Safar sacred one year, and makes Al-Muharram sacred one year
sources.orig: " النسيء "، هو أن " جُنَادة بن عوف بن أمية الكناني"، كان يوافي الموسم كلَّ عام, وكان يُكنى " أبا ثُمَامة ", (5) فينادي: " ألا إنّ أبا ثمامة لا يُحَابُ ولا يُعَابُ, (6) ألا وإن صَفَر العامِ الأوَّلِ العامَ حلالٌ"، (7) فيحله الناس, فيحرم صَفَر عامًا, ويحرِّم المحرم عامًا, فذلك قوله تعالى: (إنما النسيء زيادة في الكفر)، إلى قوله: (الكافرين). وقوله: (إنما النسيء زيادة في الكفر)، يقول: يتركون المحرم عامًا, وعامًا يحرِّمونه.
